title: Business Breakfast | Stock/Share Market News | 19th August 2026 || TV5 Money

recommendations.note: Contrarian buy on weakness ahead of NSE IPO. Multiple brokerage downgrades are a game; stock should rebound from lower levels.
recommendations.detail: Asked about BSE at current prices, Kutumba Rao said: 'As a contrarian, I would say buy BSE on weakness. Usually before a major IPO like the NSE IPO, they play this game in BSE. If the stock rebounds from lower levels definitively, it will happen.' He also noted Kranthi's point that NSE shares will be listed on BSE, boosting BSE trading volumes.

recommendations.note: Stable PSU Maharatna with good dividend yields. Definitely buy with a 3-5 year horizon.
recommendations.detail: When a caller asked whether to buy NTPC and Coal India, Kutumba Rao said: 'Definitely buy. Good dividend yields, stable companies, PSU Maharatnas. Have at least 3-5 years in view when investing in such stocks.'

recommendations.note: 6% dividend yield, personally holds shares. PSU Maharatna, buy with 3-5 year view. ~1.5% capital appreciation extra.
recommendations.detail: Kutumba Rao said: '6% dividend comes from Coal India. I personally hold Coal India shares. Even at this price, 5.5 to 6% yield works out. In addition, about 1.5% capital appreciation. Always have at least 3-5 years in view for such stocks.'

recommendations.note: Dark horse, high-priced even at Rs 30-40. Cellulose prices falling, flat results. Exit on any small rally.
recommendations.detail: A caller held 13,000 shares at Rs 31.50. Kutumba Rao said: 'The stock is high-priced even at current levels of 30-40. Exit on any small rally. It is more or less a dark horse. Whether the old factory-accident insurance claim is resolved is unclear. Sell both [Sigachi and Suzlon] and accumulate fundamentally strong companies.'

recommendations.note: Dark horse for years. Turned around but large equity and institutional selling prevent stock from rising. Lighten positions.
recommendations.detail: A caller held 4,000 shares at Rs 54.50. Kutumba Rao said: 'Suzlon has been a dark horse for many years. The stock emerged and turned around, but with large equity and intermittent institutional selling, it cannot rise. If it comes near her purchase price, lighten positions. Sell and accumulate fundamentally strong companies. She is not in the right kind of stocks.'

recommendations.note: Old investment idea from Rs 200-300 level, now multi-bagger. Hold with trailing stop loss at 19x PE, Rs 10 paid-up.
recommendations.detail: Kutumba Rao said: 'This is our old investment idea from 3 years back at 200-300, now a multi-bagger. One of the better automotive ancillary companies with monopoly products. Near 52-week high of 2,090, currently ~1,890. Hold with trailing stop loss. At just 19x PE with Rs 10 paid-up value, at some point the stock could sprint.'

recommendations.note: Attractive recent IPO in power cables/conductors. Good demand. Accumulate on dips, but limited history so be cautious.
recommendations.detail: Kutumba Rao said: 'This is one of the attractive IPOs -- a power cables and conductors company. Good demand for these products. Not much history, so be somewhat cautious. Stock has been performing well since listing and sustaining good price. Accumulate on dips whenever good declines come.'

recommendations.note: Sector fancy completely gone. Continuously lower top/lower bottom. PE 15-16. May touch 375-400 where it could turn attractive.
recommendations.detail: A caller was 15% in loss. Kutumba Rao said: 'I would avoid. However confidently management speaks, sector fancy has gone -- zero. Continuously forming lower tops and lower bottoms, near 52-week low. PE has already come to 15-16. The stock may touch even 375-400 below 450. At those lower levels at a lower PE it could become attractive.'

recommendations.note: Avoid fresh buying. Weak quarterly result, net profit fell. Continuously lower top/lower bottom despite Rs 61,000 cr order book.
recommendations.detail: Kutumba Rao said: 'If you already hold, hold. But for fresh buying, go with a more strongly positioned company. The quarterly result was weak -- net profit fell. The most recent rally to 3,200-3,300 could not sustain, came to 2,600-2,700. Rs 61,000 crore order book and Rs 16,000 crore orders in Q1, but the stock simply cannot perform.'

recommendations.note: Hold with Rs 225 trading stop loss. Consolidating after peak with flat results. Below 225, further correction risk.
recommendations.detail: A caller held 300 shares at Rs 120. Kutumba Rao said: 'Continuous activity in the stock, decent performance. Recently hit a peak and now consolidating with flat results. As of now, hold. But keep a trading stop at 225. Below 225, the stock could correct further.'

recommendations.note: Engineering fabrication. Continuous lower top/lower bottom. Weak results (top and bottom line fell). Sell near 175-180.
recommendations.detail: A caller held 800 shares at Rs 240. Kutumba Rao said: 'Hype came from solar project supply, stock went to 260-275. From there, correcting one-sidedly. Results were weak -- both top line and bottom line fell. Even though PE is at 14, I would sell the stock if it comes closer to 175-180.'

recommendations.note: Near 52-week low, results weak. Do not sell at current levels. Entertainment/leisure reflects economy; will recover.
recommendations.detail: A caller bought at Rs 885 with 50% loss. Kutumba Rao said: 'Stock is at ~473, near its 52-week low. Results not good enough -- Bangalore and Hyderabad properties underperformed. But at current levels, just hold, do not sell. This sector reflects the economy. When the economy recovers, these stocks will rise too.'

recommendations.note: Dark horse. Micro irrigation leader but continuous losses and debt not reducing. Hold as dark horse, nothing else.
recommendations.detail: A caller was 30-45% in loss. Kutumba Rao said: 'Jain Irrigation is a dark horse, as we have been saying. Leadership in micro irrigation, but continuous losses. Sometimes profit, then again losses. Debt not reducing. Just hold as a dark horse, otherwise nothing else.'

recommendations.note: Definitely underperforming. Management not good. Exit on small rallies. Cautioned many times before.
recommendations.detail: A caller held 1,000 shares at Rs 15. Kutumba Rao said: 'Easy Trip -- no. Management is not good either. We have cautioned many times. Definitely underperforming. Even now, exit on small rallies.'
